page.overview:
What is Adonis?

Adonis was a demipower of the Olympian pantheon and proxy of the goddess Aphrodite. He was once her most favorite proxy, until his loyal service came to an end when the Olympian known as Ares grew jealous and killed him. His tragic story was known to some in the Vast region of north Faerûn in the 14 century DR, for there existed a pair of cats named Adonis and Venus.

Befitting a proxy of a goddess of beauty, Adonis was a strikingly handsome fellow, to the point that one might describe someone who was handsome as being "an Adonis".
